Get P. LEAGUE+ Officials

Source: R/pleague.R
pleague_officials.Rd

The referee and the two umpires printed under the header of one finished game (names only).

Endpoint: GET https://pleagueofficial.com/game/{gid}

Usage

pleague_officials(gid)

Arguments

gid

Required. P. LEAGUE+ game id on the site: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season (197 = the 2022-23 opener, 662 = the 2025-26 opener), e.g. 197; gid in pleague_schedule. Only finished games are served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: The referee and the two umpires printed under the header of one finished game (names only). An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sdv-py pleague_officials):

col_nametypedescription
gidintegerP. LEAGUE+ game id on the site: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season (1-12 = 2020-21 pre-season, 13 = the 2020-21 opener, 197 = the 2022-23 opener, 662 = the 2025-26 opener), with gaps; a row id, not a count. The {gid} of /game/{gid}.
official_nointeger1-based position of the official in the printed line (referee first).
rolecharacterRole translated: referee ((Chinese text), the crew chief), first_umpire ((Chinese text), literally 'first inspector'), second_umpire ((Chinese text)). Null for a role this table does not know.
role_zhcharacterOfficial's role as printed: (Chinese text) = referee, (Chinese text) = first umpire, (Chinese text) = second umpire.
name_zhcharacterOfficial's name in Traditional Chinese. Names only: the page carries no ids or contact data.

Details

  • Unofficial use of a public source: these wrappers read pleagueofficial.com (P. LEAGUE+, Taiwan's men's league), keyless. The site's /user-policy (members' terms, section 11) reserves all content on the site to the service and its rights holders and forbids use, copying, adaptation or distribution without authorisation (it says nothing about automated access); robots.txt holds only Cloudflare content-signal comment lines with no Allow, Disallow or Crawl-delay rule. Use for reference only; payloads are not redistributed as release assets, and a data release needs owner sign-off. Requests are spaced at least 1 s apart per host, retries included.

  • Access: the site sits behind Cloudflare. sdv-py fetches it with curl_cffi (Chrome TLS); this R port sends a browser User-Agent through libcurl, which was served on a live check (2026-10-18); Cloudflare may still answer a request with an HTTP 403 challenge page (hoopR_asset_fetch). Redirects are not followed: the site answers an unknown gid or a season before 2020-21 with a 302 to the home page (hoopR_no_data).

  • Coverage: schedules, standings and player tables from 2020-21 (season = 2021); box scores for every finished game from 2020-21; play-by-play (with shot x / y) from 2022-23 (gid 191 on). 2020-21 and 2021-22 pages embed an empty game uuid, so they have no play-by-play and no Preciser data (hoopR_no_data). A game is keyed by gid: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season. Only finished games are served: an unplayed game, or a box or play-by-play that does not match its game page (the routes echo no id, so the game page is fetched first, cached for the session, and the body's scores, quarters and points are checked against it), raises hoopR_asset_fetch.

  • Seasons are END years (2025 = the site's slug '2024-25'). Text is Traditional Chinese as printed (names, venues, play-by-play phrases); the column descriptions gloss it in English. Ids: team_id (1-8) is stable across renames; the box player_id is the player-team membership. The box random_id is UNRELIABLE before 2022-23 (gid 13 gives one player another player's page id): join box rows on player_id, and box rows to Preciser shots on person_id, never on random_id. The date of birth is dropped from the player frame; officials appear by name only.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a redirect, a stage the season does not have, a game with no play-by-play, a season before 2020-21), hoopR_bad_request (an invalid argument, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-200, a dead connection, an empty or unreadable body, a page for another game, season, stage or player, an unfinished game, layout drift, a play-by-play phrase outside the observed vocabulary). HTTP 429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried, up to three attempts; HTTP 500 is NOT retried (the site answers 500 for an unknown id). Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.

 pleague_officials(gid = 197)
